@@ -3,7 +3,9 @@
 # to. Every entry carries an expiry, so the gate reopens on its own and the
 # entry has to be re-justified rather than quietly outliving its reason.
 #
-# Empty since Trivy v0.76.0 (2026-10-14). The four entries this file carried
+# Empty since Trivy v0.76.2 (2026-11-07): it carries go-jose/v4 4.1.6
+# (CVE-2026-116587) and `x/net` v0.62.0 (CVE-2026-78661). Before that, empty
+# since Trivy v0.76.0 (2026-10-14). The four entries this file carried
 # were all advisories against the Trivy release binary the worker image ships
 # (`/usr/local/bin/trivy`, pinned by `TRIVY_VERSION` in `Containerfile.worker`):
 # grpc-go CVE-2026-84304 and CVE-2026-84445, and Go standard-library
@@ -14,12 +16,4 @@
 #
 #   go version -m /usr/local/bin/trivy | head -1
 #   curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aquasecurity/trivy/v<version>/go.mod
-vulnerabilities:
-  - id: CVE-2026-116587
-    # go-jose DoS via crafted RSA parameters in a JWK. Fixed in go-jose 4.1.6;
-    # Trivy main carries it, v0.76.1 (the latest release) still has 4.1.5. Trivy
-    # parses JWKs only on its opt-in sigstore/Rekor attestation paths, and the
-    # worker runs it as `trivy … --server <endpoint>` without those flags.
-    paths:
-      - "usr/local/bin/trivy"
-    expired_at: 2026-12-01
+vulnerabilities: []

@@ -8,6 +8,16 @@ The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/).
 
 ## [Unreleased]
 
+### Security
+
+- **actix stack**: `actix-http` 3.20.3, `actix-web` 4.18.2 and `actix-files`
+  0.7.4 fix RUSTSEC-2026-0443, -0446, -0447, -0448 and -0455 (request
+  smuggling through chunked trailers, unbounded request decompression,
+  hidden-file disclosure through Windows short names).
+- **Worker images**: Trivy moves to v0.76.2, which carries `golang.org/x/net`
+  v0.62.0 (CVE-2026-78661, HTML parser denial of service) and go-jose 4.1.6
+  (CVE-2026-116587, whose `.trivyignore.yaml` entry is gone).
+
 ## [1.9.0] - 2026-11-05
 
 ### Changed
